name: Stylized World — free stylized textures, 3D assets and SFX
summary: Stylized hand-painted look PBR textures (stone, wood, temple walls, roofs, ground), low-poly 3D assets and game sound effects. The library moved off Patreon to its own site and all assets are now free with an account; 61 assets listed at launch, more announced.

access.notes: Credit 'Textures by Stylized World — stylizedworld.com' required; no redistribution/resale of raw files or inclusion in other libraries. Verified-email account needed.

procedure: Create a free Stylized World account and verify your email.
Browse /assets by type (textures, 3D assets, sounds, VFX) or software.
Download, then credit Stylized World in your project.

verdict.why: Nice stylized materials now free for commercial use with credit. Account-gated download, so files and formats not verified; small library.
